examPattern.totalMarks: 1 to 36 Composite Scale across English, Math, Reading, and Science

domains.name: English & Reading
topics: Production of Writing, Knowledge of Language & Conventions of Standard English
Key Ideas and Details, Craft and Structure, Integration of Knowledge

domains.name: Mathematics & Science Reasoning
topics: Number & Quantity, Algebra, Functions, Geometry, Statistics & Probability
Data Representation, Research Summaries & Conflicting Viewpoints in Science

examPattern.totalMarks: Per-Paper Scoring (+5 for correct, -1 for incorrect across Languages, Domain Subjects, and General Test)

domains.name: Section IA & IB: Languages
topics: Reading Comprehension (Factual, Narrative, Literary)
Verbal Ability, Rearranging Parts, Vocabulary & Synonyms/Antonyms

domains.name: Section II: Domain Subjects (Class 12 NCERT Aligned)
topics: Sciences (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science)
Humanities & Social Sciences (History, Political Science, Geography, Sociology)
Commerce (Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies)

domains.name: Section III: General Test
topics: Quantitative Reasoning (up to Class 8/10 NCERT)
Logical & Analytical Reasoning, General Knowledge & Current Affairs

tracks.conductingBody: British Council, IDP: IELTS Australia & Cambridge University Press & Assessment

examPattern.mode: 4-Skill Assessment (Listening, Academic Reading, Academic Writing, Face-to-Face Speaking)
examPattern.totalMarks: Band 0 to 9 Scale (Half-band reporting across all 4 skills)

domains.name: Listening (30 Minutes, 40 Questions) & Academic Reading (60 Minutes, 40 Questions)
topics: 4 recorded monologues and conversations across social and university contexts
3 long academic texts from journals/books testing skimming, logical argument, and writer opinion

domains.name: Academic Writing (60 Minutes) & Speaking (11-14 Minutes)
topics: Task 1 (150 words, 20 min): Visual chart/graph/process synthesis; Task 2 (250 words, 40 min): Discursive academic essay
Part 1 Introduction, Part 2 Individual Long Turn (Cue Card), Part 3 Two-Way Abstract Discussion

tracks.conductingBody: National Testing Agency (NTA) & IIT Joint Admission Board

examPattern.totalMarks: 300 Marks (75 Questions: 25 each in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry; +4/-1 marking)

domains.name: Mathematics (Units 1-14)
topics: Sets, Complex Numbers & Quadratics
Matrices & Determinants
Permutations, Combinations & Binomial
Integral & Differential Calculus
Coordinate Geometry & 3D Vectors
Statistics & Probability

domains.name: Physics (Units 1-20)
topics: Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Work/Energy & Rotational Dynamics
Gravitation, Properties of Solids/Liquids & Thermodynamics
Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Magnetism & EMI/AC
Optics, Dual Nature, Atoms/Nuclei & Electronic Devices

domains.name: Chemistry (Units 1-20)
topics: Physical: Atomic Structure, Thermodynamics, Equilibrium, Electrochemistry, Kinetics
Inorganic: Classification, Bonding, p/d/f-Block & Coordination Compounds
Organic: Hydrocarbons, Haloalkanes, Oxygen/Nitrogen Compounds & Biomolecules

tracks.conductingBody: National Testing Agency (NTA) & National Medical Commission (NMC)

examPattern.totalMarks: 720 Marks (180 Compulsory Questions: 45 Physics, 45 Chemistry, 90 Biology; +4/-1 marking)

domains.name: Biology - Botany & Zoology (Units 1-10)
topics: Diversity in Living World & Structural Organisation
Cell Structure & Function, Plant Physiology & Human Physiology
Reproduction, Genetics & Evolution
Biology and Human Welfare, Biotechnology & Ecology

domains.name: Chemistry (Units 1-20)
topics: Physical Chemistry (Mole Concept, Thermodynamics, Equilibrium, Kinetics, Electrochemistry)
Inorganic Chemistry (Periodic Table, Bonding, d/f Block, Coordination)
Organic Chemistry (GOC, Hydrocarbons, Functional Groups, Biomolecules)

domains.name: Physics (Units 1-20)
topics: Mechanics, Thermal Physics & Oscillations/Waves
Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Magnetic Effects & Optics
Modern Physics & Semiconductor Electronics

title.hi: कॉलेज बोर्ड डिजिटल सैट (SAT) अध्ययन विदेश ट्रैक

examPattern.mode: Digital Adaptive (2-Stage Multistage Adaptive Testing in Bluebook)
examPattern.totalMarks: 400 to 1600 Scale (200-800 Reading and Writing + 200-800 Math)

domains.name: Reading and Writing (64 Minutes, 54 Questions across 2 Modules)
topics: Craft and Structure (~28%): Words in Context, Text Structure and Purpose, Cross-Text Connections
Information and Ideas (~26%): Central Ideas, Command of Textual/Quantitative Evidence, Inferences
Standard English Conventions (~26%): Boundaries, Form, Structure, and Sense
Expression of Ideas (~20%): Rhetorical Synthesis and Transitions

domains.name: Math (70 Minutes, 44 Questions across 2 Modules)
topics: Algebra (~35%): Linear equations, systems, and inequalities
Advanced Math (~35%): Equivalent expressions, nonlinear equations, quadratics, exponentials
Problem-Solving and Data Analysis (~15%): Ratios, rates, percentages, probability, statistical inference
Geometry and Trigonometry (~15%): Area/volume, lines/angles/triangles, right-triangle trig, circles

title.en: ETS TOEFL iBT Academic English Track

examPattern.mode: Internet-Based Test (iBT) - Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing
examPattern.totalMarks: 0 to 120 Scale (30 per section) paired with ETS 1 to 6 CEFR-aligned scale (2026 update)

domains.name: Reading (35 Min, 20 Questions) & Listening (36 Min, 28 Questions)
topics: 2 university-level passages (700 words each) testing rhetorical purpose, inference, and summary
3 academic lectures and 2 campus conversations testing attitude, organization, and connection

domains.name: Speaking (16 Min, 4 Tasks) & Writing (29 Min, 2 Tasks)
topics: 1 Independent Speaking task + 3 Integrated Reading/Listening/Speaking tasks
Integrated Writing task (20 min) + Writing for an Academic Discussion task (10 min)

title.en: UPSC Civil Services (CSE) NCERT Foundation & Prelims/Mains Spine
title.hi: यूपीएससी सिविल सेवा (सीएसई) एनसीईआरटी आधार और प्रारंभिक/मुख्य ट्रैक

examPattern.mode: Prelims Objective (GS Paper I + CSAT Paper II) -> Mains Written (9 Papers) -> Personality Test
examPattern.totalMarks: Prelims: 200 Marks per paper (CSAT qualifying at 33%); Mains: 1750 Marks + 275 Interview

domains.name: General Studies Paper I (NCERT Class 6-12 Spine)
topics: Indian Polity and Governance (Constitution, Rights, Federalism, Panchayati Raj)
History of India and Indian National Movement + Art & Culture
Indian and World Geography + Environment, Biodiversity & Climate Change
Economic and Social Development, Sustainable Development & General Science

domains.name: CSAT Paper II (Class X Level Numeracy & Comprehension)
topics: Reading Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication
Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Data Interpretation
Basic Numeracy (Numbers, Orders of Magnitude - Class X Level)

sources.authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD), Government of India
sources.title: Navchetana - National Framework for Early Childhood Stimulation for Children from Birth to Three Years (2024)
sources.scopeNotes: Governs home-0-3 stimulation across sensory, motor, cognitive, language, and caregiver bonding milestones.

sources.authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD), Government of India
sources.title: Aadharshila - National Curriculum for Early Childhood Care and Education for Children from Three to Six Years (2024)
sources.scopeNotes: Governs nursery, LKG, and UKG play-based weekly and daily schedules across Panchakosha domains.

sources.authority: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
sources.title: National Curriculum Framework for Foundational Stage (NCF-FS) 2022
sources.scopeNotes: Defines Curricular Goals and Competencies for ages 3 to 8 (Nursery, LKG, UKG, Class 1, Class 2).

sources.authority: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
sources.title: National Curriculum Framework for School Education (NCF-SE) 2023
sources.scopeNotes: Defines 5+3+3+4 stages, Curricular Goals, Competencies, notional hours, and assessment principles from Foundational to Secondary Class 12.

sources.authority: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
sources.title: National Syllabus and Teaching-Learning Material Committee (NSTC) Notification and NEP 2020 Alignment
sources.scopeNotes: Governs new NCERT syllabus and textbook development across Classes 1 to 12 under NCF-SE 2023.

sources.authority: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE Academics Unit)
sources.title: CBSE Secondary and Senior Secondary School Curriculum 2026-27
sources.scopeNotes: Official CBSE scheme of studies, subject codes, internal assessment rubrics, and annual board exam weightages.

sources.authority: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE Academics Unit)
sources.title: CBSE Secondary School Curriculum 2026-27 Part 1 Academic Guidelines
sources.scopeNotes: Details CBSE competency-based assessment structure, 20-mark internal assessment, and 80-mark board theory blueprint.

sources.authority: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE)
sources.title: CISCE Curriculum Pre-School to Class VIII and Regulations & Syllabuses for ICSE (Class X) and ISC (Class XII)
sources.scopeNotes: Official CISCE publication index for Pre-School to Class 8, ICSE Class 9-10 Group I/II/III subjects, and ISC Class 11-12 streams.

sources.authority: National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS)
sources.title: NIOS Open Basic Education (OBE Levels A, B, C) Equivalent to Classes 3, 5, and 8
sources.scopeNotes: Official open-schooling elementary equivalence levels for learners outside conventional schools.

sources.authority: National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS)
sources.title: NIOS Secondary (Class 10) and Senior Secondary (Class 12) Subject List and Scheme of Studies
sources.scopeNotes: Defines NIOS subject codes, Tutor Marked Assignment (TMA) weightages, and Public / On-Demand Exam pathways.

sources.authority: Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (MSBSHSE) & Tamil Nadu DGE
sources.title: State Board SSC / HSC Academic Portal and Equivalency Reference
sources.scopeNotes: Representative state board reference mapped onto the NCF-SE shared skill graph; state-specific language chapters are labelled as Phase 3 ingestion items.

sources.authority: National Testing Agency (NTA)
sources.title: Syllabus for Joint Entrance Examination JEE (Main) 2026
sources.scopeNotes: Official JEE Main Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry syllabus units and CBT Paper 1 examination structure.

sources.authority: National Testing Agency (NTA) & National Medical Commission (NMC)
sources.title: Syllabus for NEET (UG) 2026 Examination
sources.scopeNotes: Official Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Botany and Zoology) unit syllabus notified by NMC UGMEB and NTA.

sources.authority: National Testing Agency (NTA)
sources.title: CUET (UG) 2026 Official Syllabus Portal
sources.scopeNotes: Covers Section IA/IB Languages, Section II Domain-Specific Subjects (Class 12 NCERT aligned), and Section III General Test.

sources.authority: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
sources.title: UPSC Civil Services Examination Revised Syllabus and Scheme (Prelims GS, CSAT, and Mains)
sources.scopeNotes: Official scheme for Prelims Paper I (General Studies) and Paper II (CSAT) plus Mains papers.

sources.authority: College Board
sources.title: Assessment Framework and Test Specifications for the Digital SAT Suite
sources.scopeNotes: Defines Reading and Writing domains (Craft and Structure, Information and Ideas, Standard English Conventions, Expression of Ideas) and Math domains (Algebra, Advanced Math, Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Geometry and Trigonometry).

sources.authority: ACT, Inc. ( Consequential Validity & College Readiness Benchmarks )
sources.title: ACT Test Structure and College Readiness Standards (English, Math, Reading, Science)
sources.scopeNotes: Maps ACT English, Mathematics, Reading, and Science Reasoning onto secondary school skill nodes; full ACT item bank labelled for Phase 4 expansion.

sources.authority: IELTS Official (British Council, IDP, Cambridge)
sources.title: IELTS Academic Test Format and Four-Skill Assessment Specification
sources.scopeNotes: Defines Listening (30 min), Academic Reading (60 min), Academic Writing Task 1 & 2 (60 min), and Speaking Parts 1-3 (11-14 min) on the 0-9 band scale.

sources.authority: Educational Testing Service (ETS)
sources.title: TOEFL iBT Test Content, Structure, and 2026 Score Scale (1-6 CEFR & 0-120)
sources.scopeNotes: Defines Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing tasks for the under-2-hour TOEFL iBT format.

sources.authority: University Grants Commission (UGC), NCERT, NCVET, AICTE
sources.title: Report of the High-Level Committee on National Credit Framework (NCrF)
sources.scopeNotes: Establishes 1,200 notional learning hours per academic year (40 credits) across school and higher education.

sources.authority: PARAKH National Assessment Centre, NCERT
sources.title: PARAKH Rashtriya Sarvekshan 2024 Assessment Framework and Holistic Progress Card Equivalence
sources.scopeNotes: Sets stage-end competency benchmarks at Classes 3, 6, and 9 and cross-board equivalence standards.

sources.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India
sources.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 Section 9 and DPDP Rules 2025 Rule 10 (Children's Data)
sources.scopeNotes: Mandates verifiable parental consent and prohibits tracking, behavioral monitoring, and targeted ads for children under 18.

sources.authority: Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP)
sources.title: Indian Academy of Pediatrics Guidelines on Screen Time and Digital Wellness in Infants, Children and Adolescents
sources.scopeNotes: Mandates zero screens under 24 months, <1 hour/day supervised co-viewing for ages 2-5, and balanced digital hygiene for ages 5-18.

sources.authority: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India
sources.title: UDISE+ 2024-25 All-India School Education Report
sources.scopeNotes: Primary national dataset for school enrollment, infrastructure, and stage-wise student distribution.

name.en: Early Childhood Stimulation & Panchakosha Development
name.hi: प्रारंभिक बाल प्रोत्साहन और पंचकोश विकास

domains.description: Sensory, gross/fine motor, socio-emotional, and play-based stimulation for birth to 6 years under MWCD Navchetana and Aadharshila.

name.en: Foundational Bilingual Literacy (Hindi & English)
name.hi: बुनियादी द्विभाषी साक्षरता (हिंदी और अंग्रेजी)

domains.description: Oral language, phonological awareness, decoding, reading fluency, and early writing across Nursery to Class 5.

name.en: Foundational Numeracy & Spatial Sense
name.hi: बुनियादी संख्या ज्ञान और स्थानिक समझ

domains.description: Pre-number concepts, counting, place value, four operations, shapes, and measurement from Nursery to Class 5.

name.en: Middle & Secondary Mathematics
name.hi: माध्यमिक और उच्चतर गणित

domains.description: Number systems, algebra, geometry, mensuration, trigonometry, calculus, probability, and statistics from Class 6 to Class 12 and competitive tracks.

name.en: Science, Physics, Chemistry & Biology
name.hi: विज्ञान, भौतिकी, रसायन और जीवविज्ञान

domains.description: Environmental studies, scientific inquiry, physics, chemistry, and biology from Class 3 to Class 12 and JEE/NEET tracks.

name.en: Social Science, Polity, Economy & History
name.hi: सामाजिक विज्ञान, राजव्यवस्था, अर्थव्यवस्था और इतिहास

domains.description: History, geography, social and political life, economics, and Indian constitutional foundations from Class 6 to Class 12 and UPSC/CUET tracks.

name.en: Academic Reading, Rhetoric & Global English/Hindi
name.hi: शैक्षणिक पठन, लेखन और वैश्विक भाषा कौशल

domains.description: Reading comprehension, grammar conventions, analytical writing, and speaking proficiency for Classes 6-12 and SAT/ACT/IELTS/TOEFL.

name.en: Computational Thinking, Data & AI Literacy
name.hi: कम्प्यूटेशनल चिंतन, डेटा और एआई साक्षरता

domains.description: Algorithmic logic, data representation, coding fundamentals, and responsible AI literacy across Middle and Secondary stages.

name.en: Sensory Tracking, Grasp & Caregiver Bonding
name.hi: संवेदी समन्वय, पकड़ और देखभालकर्ता जुड़ाव

skills.description: Infant and toddler sensory tracking, object permanence, rhythmic movement, and responsive serve-and-return caregiver interaction.
successCriteria: Follows moving objects and responds to caregiver voice and gestures
Manipulates safe household objects, stacks blocks, and coordinates balance

name.en: First Words, Songs & Bilingual Listening (0-3)
name.hi: प्रथम शब्द, बालगीत और द्विभाषी श्रवण (0-3)

skills.description: Oral stimulation through mother-tongue and English rhymes, naming everyday objects, and two-word expressive phrases.
successCriteria: Points to named household objects and body parts in home language
Uses simple words and gestures to express needs during play

name.en: Panchakosha Motor, Socio-Emotional & Creative Play
name.hi: पंचकोश शारीरिक, सामाजिक-भावनात्मक और रचनात्मक खेल

skills.description: Fine motor clay/paper work, turn-taking in group games, emotion recognition, and rhythmic movement under Aadharshila and NCF-FS.
successCriteria: Demonstrates fine-motor control with crayons, beads, and paper folding
Takes turns, shares materials, and follows 2-step game rules in a peer pod

name.en: Phonological & Akshara Sound-Symbol Awareness
name.hi: ध्वनि जागरूकता और अक्षर-ध्वनि पहचान

skills.description: Recognizing beginning and ending sounds, rhyming patterns, Devanagari Varnamala aksharas, and English letter-sound correspondence.
successCriteria: Identifies initial sounds of familiar Hindi and English words
Matches core Devanagari aksharas and English letters to their phonetic sounds

name.en: Guided Story Reading & Comprehension (Classes 1-5)
name.hi: धाराप्रवाह कहानी पठन और अर्थग्रहण (कक्षा 1-5)

skills.description: Reading short graded stories with comprehension in Hindi and English, answering literal and inferential questions, and writing short paragraphs.
successCriteria: Reads age-graded text aloud at target fluency with comprehension
Answers who, what, why questions and writes 4-6 coherent sentences

name.en: Pre-Number Sorting, Patterns & Counting 1 to 20
name.hi: पूर्व-संख्या वर्गीकरण, पैटर्न और 1 से 20 तक गिनती

skills.description: One-to-one correspondence, comparing more/less, sorting by shape and size, and counting concrete objects up to 20.
successCriteria: Counts up to 20 objects accurately using one-to-one correspondence
Extends simple ABAB and AABB visual patterns

name.en: Base-10 Place Value, Addition & Subtraction
name.hi: स्थानीय मान, जोड़ और घटाव

skills.description: Understanding tens, hundreds, and thousands, regrouping in addition and subtraction, and solving word problems.
successCriteria: Decomposes 2-digit and 3-digit numbers into hundreds, tens, and ones
Solves addition and subtraction word problems with regrouping

name.en: Multiplication, Division, Factors & Introductory Fractions
name.hi: गुणा, भाग, गुणनखंड और भिन्न की शुरुआत

skills.description: Multi-digit multiplication and division, multiples and factors, equivalent fractions, decimals, and area/perimeter of rectangles.
successCriteria: Performs multi-digit division and interprets remainders in context
Compares fractions with unlike denominators using equivalence

name.en: Integers, Prime Factorisation & Number Patterns (Ganita Prakash)
name.hi: पूर्णांक, अभाज्य गुणनखंड और संख्या पैटर्न (गणित प्रकाश)

skills.description: Patterns in numbers, prime time factorisation, negative integers on the number line, and operations on rational numbers.
successCriteria: Adds, subtracts, multiplies, and divides signed integers and fractions accurately
Identifies figurate number sequences, HCF/LCM, and divisibility properties

name.en: Algebraic Expressions, Linear Equations & Proportional Reasoning
name.hi: बीजीय व्यंजक, रैखिक समीकरण और अनुपात-समानुपात

skills.description: Forming algebraic expressions, solving one-variable linear equations, percentages, compound interest, and direct/inverse proportions.
successCriteria: Translates word problems into single-variable linear equations and solves them
Applies ratio, percentage change, and direct/inverse proportion in real scenarios

trackBranches.officialExamRef: UPSC CSAT Basic Numeracy (Class X level)

name.en: Euclidean Lines, Triangles, Symmetry & Mensuration
name.hi: रेखाएं, त्रिभुज, सममिति और क्षेत्रमिति

skills.description: Angle relationships, triangle congruence criteria, Pythagoras property, rotational symmetry, and surface area/volume of 3D solids.
successCriteria: Proves angle and triangle properties using parallel line and congruence rules
Computes area and volume of prisms, cylinders, and composite polygons

name.en: Polynomials, Quadratic Equations & Arithmetic Progressions (Classes 9-10)
name.hi: बहुपद, द्विघात समीकरण और समांतर श्रेढ़ी (कक्षा 9-10)

skills.description: Real numbers, polynomial factorisation, pair of linear equations in two variables, quadratic equations, and arithmetic progressions.
successCriteria: Solves systems of linear equations and analyses discriminant of quadratic equations
Models nth term and sum of arithmetic progressions

trackBranches.officialExamRef: JEE Main Unit 2 Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations

name.en: Coordinate Geometry, Trigonometry & Circles (Classes 9-10)
name.hi: निर्देशांक ज्यामिति, त्रिकोणमिति और वृत्त (कक्षा 9-10)

skills.description: Distance and section formulas, similarity of triangles, tangent theorems on circles, trigonometric ratios, identities, and heights and distances.
successCriteria: Applies trigonometric ratios and identities to elevation and depression problems
Solves coordinate geometry and circle tangent proofs

name.en: Sets, Functions, Limits, Differential & Integral Calculus (Classes 11-12)
name.hi: समुच्चय, फलन, सीमा, अवकलन और समाकलन (कक्षा 11-12)

skills.description: Sets and relations, limits and continuity, differentiation, applications of derivatives, definite and indefinite integration, differential equations, vectors, and 3D geometry.
successCriteria: Evaluates limits, derivatives, extrema, and definite integrals of transcendental and algebraic functions
Solves linear differential equations and 3D line/plane vector problems

trackBranches.officialExamRef: JEE Main Units 6-12 Calculus & Vector Algebra

prompt.en: Aarav arranges clay beads in the pattern: Red, Blue, Red, Blue, Red, [ ? ]. Which bead comes next?
prompt.hi: आरव मिट्टी के मोतियों को इस क्रम में रखता है: लाल, नीला, लाल, नीला, लाल, [ ? ]। अगला मोती कौन-सा होगा?

explanation.en: The pattern alternates Red and Blue (ABAB). After Red, the next bead is Blue.
explanation.hi: यह लाल और नीले का एकांतर (ABAB) पैटर्न है। लाल के बाद नीला मोती आएगा।

prompt.en: Meera has 3 bundles of 10 sticks and 14 loose sticks. What total number of sticks does she have?
prompt.hi: मीरा के पास 10-10 तीलियों के 3 गट्ठर और 14 खुली तीलियां हैं। उसके पास कुल कितनी तीलियां हैं?

explanation.en: 3 tens = 30, plus 14 ones (1 ten + 4 ones) = 4 tens and 4 ones = 44.

prompt.en: Which of the following fractions is equivalent to 3/4?
prompt.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी भिन्न 3/4 के समतुल्य है?

explanation.en: Multiplying numerator and denominator of 3/4 by 3 gives (3 x 3)/(4 x 3) = 9/12.
explanation.hi: 3/4 के अंश और हर को 3 से गुणा करने पर 9/12 प्राप्त होता है।

prompt.en: In Srinagar, the temperature at midnight is -4 C. By morning it drops by another 3 C. What is the morning temperature?
prompt.hi: श्रीनगर में आधी रात का तापमान -4 C है। सुबह तक यह 3 C और गिर जाता है। सुबह का तापमान क्या है?

explanation.en: Starting at -4 and moving 3 units left on the number line gives (-4) + (-3) = -7 C.
explanation.hi: संख्या रेखा पर -4 से 3 इकाई बाईं ओर जाने पर (-4) - 3 = -7 C मिलता है।

prompt.en: Solve for x: 3(2x - 1) = 4x + 7
prompt.hi: x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए: 3(2x - 1) = 4x + 7

explanation.en: Expanding gives 6x - 3 = 4x + 7 -> 2x = 10 -> x = 5.
explanation.hi: विस्तार करने पर 6x - 3 = 4x + 7 -> 2x = 10 -> x = 5 प्राप्त होता है।

prompt.en: When a few drops of dilute iodine solution are added to boiled rice, it turns blue-black. This indicates the presence of:
prompt.hi: जब उबले हुए चावल में तनु आयोडीन घोल की कुछ बूंदें डाली जाती हैं, तो वह नीला-काला हो जाता है। यह किसकी उपस्थिति दर्शाता है?

explanation.en: Iodine reacts with amylose in starch to form a characteristic blue-black complex (NCERT Curiosity).
explanation.hi: आयोडीन स्टार्च (मंड) के साथ अभिक्रिया करके नीला-काला रंग देता है (एनसीईआरटी जिज्ञासा)।

prompt.en: For what value of k does the quadratic equation x^2 - 6x + k = 0 have two equal real roots?
prompt.hi: k के किस मान के लिए द्विघात समीकरण x^2 - 6x + k = 0 के दो बराबर वास्तविक मूल होंगे?

explanation.en: Equal real roots occur when discriminant D = b^2 - 4ac = 0 -> (-6)^2 - 4(1)(k) = 0 -> 36 - 4k = 0 -> k = 9.
explanation.hi: बराबर मूलों के लिए विविक्तकर D = b^2 - 4ac = 0 -> 36 - 4k = 0 -> k = 9।

prompt.en: What is the derivative d/dx of f(x) = x^3 - 5x^2 + 7 at x = 2?
prompt.hi: x = 2 पर फलन f(x) = x^3 - 5x^2 + 7 का अवकलज (d/dx) क्या है?

explanation.en: f'(x) = 3x^2 - 10x. Evaluating at x = 2 gives 3(4) - 10(2) = 12 - 20 = -8.

prompt.en: Choose the punctuation that conforms to Standard English conventions: 'Solar microgrids reduce transmission losses ______ they require local battery storage to handle monsoon cloud cover.'
prompt.hi: मानक अंग्रेजी विराम-चिह्न चुनें: 'Solar microgrids reduce transmission losses ______ they require local battery storage to handle monsoon cloud cover.'

explanation.en: Joining two independent clauses with the conjunctive adverb 'however' requires a semicolon before and a comma after.
explanation.hi: दो स्वतंत्र उपवाक्यों को 'however' से जोड़ने के लिए पहले अर्धविराम (;) और बाद में अल्पविराम (,) आवश्यक है।

prompt.en: Two resistors of 4 Ohm and 12 Ohm are connected in parallel across a 6 V battery. What is the equivalent resistance of the circuit?
prompt.hi: 4 ओम और 12 ओम के दो प्रतिरोधक 6 V बैटरी के साथ समांतर क्रम में जुड़े हैं। परिपथ का तुल्य प्रतिरोध क्या है?

prompt.en: If sin(theta) = 3/5 for an acute angle theta, what is the value of cos(theta)?
prompt.hi: यदि न्यून कोण theta के लिए sin(theta) = 3/5 है, तो cos(theta) का मान क्या होगा?

explanation.en: Using sin^2(theta) + cos^2(theta) = 1 -> cos(theta) = sqrt(1 - 9/25) = sqrt(16/25) = 4/5.
explanation.hi: sin^2(theta) + cos^2(theta) = 1 से cos(theta) = sqrt(1 - 9/25) = 4/5।

prompt.en: A particle of mass m is projected with velocity v at 45 degrees to the horizontal. What is the magnitude of its angular momentum about the point of projection at maximum height?
prompt.hi: द्रव्यमान m के एक कण को क्षैतिज से 45 डिग्री पर वेग v से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। अधिकतम ऊंचाई पर प्रक्षेपण बिंदु के सापेक्ष इसका कोणीय संवेग क्या होगा?

explanation.en: At max height H = v^2 sin^2(45)/(2g) = v^2/(4g), speed is v cos(45) = v/sqrt(2). Thus L = m (v/sqrt(2)) H = m v^3 / (4 sqrt(2) g).
explanation.hi: अधिकतम ऊंचाई H = v^2/(4g) और क्षैतिज वेग v/sqrt(2) से L = m v_x H = m v^3 / (4 sqrt(2) g)।

prompt.en: What is the value of the definite integral from 0 to pi/2 of sin^2(x) dx?
prompt.hi: 0 से pi/2 तक sin^2(x) dx के निश्चित समाकलन का मान क्या है?

explanation.en: By symmetry I = int_0^(pi/2) sin^2(x) dx = int_0^(pi/2) cos^2(x) dx -> 2I = pi/2 -> I = pi/4.
explanation.hi: सममिति गुणधर्म से 2I = pi/2, अतः I = pi/4।

prompt.en: Which enzyme is thermostable and catalyses the extension step during Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR)?
prompt.hi: पॉलीमरेज़ चेन रिएक्शन (PCR) के दौरान कौन-सा ताप-स्थायी एंजाइम डीएनए विस्तार (extension) को उत्प्रेरित करता है?

explanation.en: Taq DNA polymerase isolated from Thermus aquaticus remains active during high-temperature denaturation in PCR.
explanation.hi: Thermus aquaticus से प्राप्त टैक डीएनए पॉलीमरेज़ उच्च तापमान पर भी सक्रिय रहता है।

prompt.en: For a first-order chemical reaction with rate constant k = 0.693 min^-1, what is the half-life (t_1/2)?
prompt.hi: यदि किसी प्रथम कोटि की अभिक्रिया का वेग स्थिरांक k = 0.693 min^-1 है, तो उसकी अर्ध-आयु (t_1/2) क्या होगी?

explanation.en: For first-order kinetics, t_1/2 = 0.693 / k = 0.693 / 0.693 = 1.0 minute.
explanation.hi: प्रथम कोटि अभिक्रिया के लिए t_1/2 = 0.693 / k = 1.0 मिनट।

explanation.en: Combined daily rate = 1/12 + 1/24 = 3/24 = 1/8 job per day -> 8 days.

prompt.en: If 4x + 3y = 29 and 3x - 3y = 6, what is the value of x + y?
prompt.hi: यदि 4x + 3y = 29 और 3x - 3y = 6 है, तो x + y का मान क्या होगा?

explanation.en: Adding the two equations gives 7x = 35 -> x = 5. Substituting x = 5 into 4(5) + 3y = 29 gives 3y = 9 -> y = 3. Thus x + y = 8.

prompt.en: Archaeologists studying stepwells in Gujarat note that these structures served dual purposes: providing year-round groundwater access and ______ cool communal gathering spaces during summer heatwaves.

explanation.en: Parallel grammatical structure requires the participial phrase 'offering...' to match 'providing...'.
